_about: Propionic acid (1) + Water (2): total pressures against temperature, 423.2-483.2 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of propionic acid, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: L. A. Roman-Ramirez, F. Garcia-Sanchez, R. C. D. Santos, G. A. Leeke, Vapour-liquid equilibrium of propanoic acid + water at 423.2, 453.2 and 483.2 K from 1.87 to 19.38 bar. Experimental and modelling with PR, CPA, PC-SAFT and PCP-SAFT, Fluid Phase Equilib. 388 (2015) 151-159
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 1. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
